description: This file contains template method implementations for the CameraDevice class related to capturing requests, setting repeating requests, and submitting request lists within the Android camera framework. It includes external references to camera request and session classes, and manages request submission, error handling, and callback registration.

methods.name: captureLocked
methods.description: Submits a capture request in a locked state, optionally with callbacks and capture sequence ID.

methods.name: setRepeatingRequestsLocked
methods.description: Sets a repeating capture request in a locked state, with optional callbacks and capture sequence ID.

methods.name: submitRequestsLocked
methods.description: Handles the core logic of submitting a list of capture requests, managing request conversion, error handling, and callback registration.
